summary: Busy Saturday: 20 of 51 games researched (Ligue 1, Eredivisie, La Liga, Serie A, Bundesliga, Premier League, Liiga, SHL and a Dota 2 series). Two kept at medium, both as goals legs on big home favourites: PSV v Go Ahead Eagles under 5.5 goals and PSG under 3.5 team goals v Lorient. DraftKings, Winamax (PSG) and bet365 (PSV) agree with Polymarket on both results within about 3 points. Excluded: Ilves v HIFK and HV71 v Björklöven (fixture, goalies and coach status could not be verified, and no two-way price was found) and JYP v KalPa (local press calls it the Lakeland derby). Rated low: Real Madrid, Inter, Nice, Atlético, Bayern, Athletic and Lens for unconfirmed team news, a 60-70% favourite or a weak second price; Mainz; Leeds (five draws in 11); Frosinone (lost the last two, models split); Betis (DraftKings drifted from 1.51 to 1.65, likely rotation, four straight draws in this fixture); Stuttgart v Frankfurt (5.6% DraftKings drift after Inter away); Ipswich v Villa (Villa tired after Galatasaray, three of the last four meetings drawn); Malmö v Djurgården (goalies unconfirmed, regulation-only price); PARIVISION v 1w (no second price). Brynäs was skipped after a 3.5% move against them. The rest are under 60% or coin flips. This morning the slip was two legs at about 1.71, under the 1.8 target: about 55% to land, still negative expected value. Midday backup check (12:10 UTC): Real Madrid (Trent confirmed out, rotation expected, still no second price) and Inter (Bastoni, Calhanoglu and Bonny out, no second price) got a second, deeper pass and both stay low. The PSG leg's price then shortened from 1.37 to about 1.32, so the slip is now about 1.65, below the usual range. The games still unresearched either sit under 60% or have drifted against the favourite at DraftKings (Charleroi, Arouca, Vitória), so there is no honest third leg today: this is a weak slip.

Endrick (adductor), Asencio (tibia stress fracture) and Rodrygo (ACL) are out (Comuniate, Sports Mole). Alavés are without Garces and Mikel Rodríguez (both ACL) and Hugo Novoa (hamstring); Infobae/EFE also lists Protesoni out and Comuniate has Benavídez with an adductor problem. checks.lineups: No predicted XI dated 28 Nov. Sports Mole (26-27 Nov): Courtois; Dumfries, Konaté, Huijsen, Cucurella; Valverde, Tchouaméni; Güler, Bellingham, Vinícius; Mbappé. Infobae/EFE (27 Nov) has Bellingham returning, Mbappé up front, Vinícius and Diomande wide, Carreras and Dumfries at full-back. They agree on Bellingham, Mbappé and Dumfries and disagree on Diomande, Güler and the left-back. Alavés XIs also differ (back four vs back three). Roughly 4-6 changes from the PSV side expected; nothing confirmed.

Mourinho said three days is enough to recover and he sees no ideal XI. Nothing confirms a 5+ change heavily rotated side, so the exclusion does not apply. Next fixture not verified.
checks.motivation: Sports Mole (26 Nov): Madrid are 2nd, 3 points behind Barcelona, and a win would draw them level; 6 straight La Liga wins, 10 in all competitions. Alavés are 9th with 16 points from 13 games. Not a derby. Mourinho appointed June 2026; no recent manager change at either club.
checks.form: Alavés' last six La Liga results: L, L, D, L, D, W (Sports Mole); won their last two per Infobae. No away win this season (D3 L3, 4 scored, 11 conceded). Madrid won the last six league games and beat PSV 5-1. No xG found.
checks.h2h: Madrid have won the last 9 meetings, including 2-1 at home in 2025-26 (Sports Mole), and 38 of 46 overall. Alavés' last win was 2-1 at the Bernabéu in Nov 2020. Draws are rare, though Alavés equalised before Madrid won in April 2026.
checks.odds: DraftKings (ESPN, 12:10 UTC): Madrid 1.143, draw 9.0, Alavés 17.0, total 3.5; de-vigged about 83.7/10.6/5.6. Opened -700 / draw n/a / +1200, so the Alavés price drifted out. 24h Polymarket move -1.1% relative (under 3%). Live Polymarket 85.5/9.5/4.75. No independent second bookmaker price found (Oddschecker 403; Flashscore page was last season's; older bet365 prices not used). No Stake or Rainbet prices.
checks.models: Foresportia's projection (search snippet only, page 403, undated method): 63.5 / 24.6 / 11.9, far from the market, used only as a mild caution on the draw. Sports Mole editorial pick 3-1 Madrid. No Opta, ClubElo, Forebet or Kickoff.co.uk forecast found.
checks.venue_weather: Santiago Bernabéu, Saturday 28 Nov, 21:00 local (20:00 UTC), referee Soto Grado. Normal home venue. No weather or pitch information found.

games.reason: Midday second pass. Started from the market (86.3/9.2/4.5) and the DraftKings de-vig (83.7/10.6/5.6) and stayed between them: 83.5 / 11 / 5.5. For Madrid: ten straight wins, nine straight over Alavés, and Alavés have no away win. Against: Trent out (confirmed), a third game in about eight days with some rotation, predicted XIs disagree, the Alavés price drifted from +1200 to +1600, and one model puts the draw at 24.6%. No source dated 28 Nov, no confirmed lineup and no independent second price, so confidence stays low.
games.main_risk: A partly rotated Madrid side play a third game in about eight days against a compact, pressing Alavés who score once, so it ends 1-1 or 2-1, which fails the -1.5 handicap and the team-goals legs.

checks.team_news: PSG medical update (27 Nov): Nuno Mendes out with a left thigh strain; Kvaratskhelia (cruciate ligament, out for the season), Doue (knee) and Longoni also out. CulturePSG headlines say 4 to 5 absentees, possibly more. Lorient: Katseris (muscle) and Fadiga (hamstring) out, Bamba doubtful, Toure uncertain per previews. I could not read the text of Luis Enrique's 27 Nov press conference, only the headline quote 'On ouvre la porte aux joueurs pour penser de maniere differente'. I did not reach L'Equipe, Le Parisien, RMC or psg.fr directly.
checks.lineups: Two sources, and they disagree on PSG's attack. Eurosport/Get French Football News style XI: Safonov; Hakimi, Marquinhos, Pacho, Mendes or Hernandez; Zaire-Emery, Vitinha, Ruiz or Dro Fernandez; Dembele, Mayulu, Godts (Torres also tipped). Eurosport still lists Mendes, which conflicts with the club's medical update. Lorient probable: Mvogo; Adjei, Talbi, Obaretin or Toure; Sylla, Avom, Cadiou, Kouassi; Makengo, Bernardeau; Tosin or Balde. No confirmed XI yet (kick-off 20:45 Paris time).

Expected changes are not confirmed; the XIs above imply a few changes and an unsettled attack, but I found no source saying 5 or more. Lorient last played 22 Nov (1-1 vs Rennes), so they have a full week's rest.
checks.motivation: PSG lead Ligue 1 on 26 points from 11 (8W 2D 1L), three points ahead of Paris FC, so the game matters for the title race. Lorient are 10th with 16 points, mid-table, nothing decisive at stake. Not a derby. I found no coach sacking or appointment at either club in the last 7 days.
checks.form: PSG: five straight league wins before the 2-2 draw with Roma midweek; 4-2 win over Man City and 10 goals in two earlier Champions League games. Lorient: 2W 2D 1L in their last 5 league games, one defeat in their last 6, 1-1 vs Rennes on 22 Nov. Lorient away: 4 goals scored and 4 clean sheets in 5 away league games, only loss 2-1 at Le Mans; 9 goals conceded in 11 games overall, 10 scored from 13.4 xG (Eurosport).
checks.h2h: All-time 44 meetings: PSG 24 wins, 10 draws, Lorient 10 wins. Last meeting 2-2 at the Parc des Princes on 2 May 2026 (Luis Enrique 'frustrated' by the draw). PSG have not beaten Lorient at the Parc since a 5-1 on 3 April 2022. Style: PSG dominate possession, Lorient defend deep in a back three and counter.
checks.odds: DraftKings (ESPN): PSG 1.19, draw 7.5, Lorient 13, opened 1.21 / 6.5 / 11, de-vigged 80.0 / 12.7 / 7.3, so a small shorten on PSG and no drift against the favourite. Winamax (via Footmercato): PSG 1.14, draw 7.50, Lorient 10.50, de-vigged about 79.4 / 12.1 / 8.6. Eurosport (26 Nov): BTTS No 1.75, Under 2.5 at 2.45, PSG 2-0 correct score 7.00. Polymarket 82.4 / 12.3 / 5.3, move_24h +2.5% for PSG. Independent prices agree with Polymarket within about 3 points. No Stake or Rainbet prices seen.
checks.models: Not found: I did not find an Opta, ClubElo or Forebet forecast for this game. The only forecast I read was Eurosport's own tip of PSG 2-0 with BTTS No and Under 2.5, which is an editorial pick, not a bookmaker-free model.
checks.venue_weather: Parc des Princes, Paris, home ground, normal venue. I found no weather or pitch report and no sign of a problem; the game is a late kick-off (20:45 Paris, 19:45 UTC) in late November, so cold is the only likely factor.

games.reason: Started from the market (PSG 82.4%) and moved 3 points to the draw. Reasons: PSG drew 2-2 with Roma on Wednesday, drew 2-2 with Lorient at the Parc in May and have not beaten them there since April 2022, and they are missing Mendes, Kvaratskhelia and Doue so the attack is thinner. Offsetting this, five straight league wins, Lorient's 0.8 goals per away game and DraftKings/Winamax both de-vigging to about 79-80% for PSG, so I did not cut further. A straight win is fine under the 25% draw rule.
games.main_risk: A draw (or a late equaliser) as in the 2-2 with Lorient in May: PSG, tired after the Roma draw and without Mendes, Kvaratskhelia and Doue, dominate but fail to convert while Lorient's back three and counters take one chance.

Genoa coach is Daniele De Rossi (in post since late 2025, no change in the last 7 days per genoacfc.it) and Inter's coach is Chivu; no coaching change found at either club. Genoa face Inter twice in four days, so they may see this as a free hit.

Genoa: W W W L W in the last five, but only 13 goals in 12 league games (about 1.1 per game) and 16 conceded. No xG and no home/away split found.
checks.h2h: Not researched in depth. Search results only showed earlier meetings (Dec 2025 at Genoa; a Feb 2026 league game at San Siro, details not read). I have no verified scores or draw-rate, and the Coppa Italia tie on 1 Dec means the same two sides meet again within days.

checks.team_news: The 24h drop in Bayern's price is explained by team news. Bayern are without Kane (ankle or syndesmosis ligament injury, reported as out for months), Olise (bruised foot, confirmed out by Kompany on Fri 27 Nov), Neuer and Saibari. Musiala is out with a muscular problem after being reinjured as a sub at Lille, though reports differ on how. Gnabry and Davies only returned to training on Friday and look like bench options at best. Diaz is back. Hamburg are without Remberg (out for the season), Poulsen, Muheim, Lokonga and Nadir, and Vuskovic may debut. I found no suspensions. I could not reach Kicker, Bild or Abendblatt directly, so this rests on Yahoo, Sky, Sports Mole and Bundesliga.com.
checks.lineups: Nothing is confirmed; the official XIs come about 60 minutes before kickoff. The two predicted XIs (Yahoo and Sports Mole) agree on the overall shape, with Urbig in goal, Kimmich and Pavlovic in midfield, Karl and Brown in attack and Upamecano in defence. They differ in places: Yahoo has Kim, Stanisic and Bischof, while Sports Mole has Tah, Ito and Diaz. Sports Mole has Hamburg as Fernandes; Nandja, Bornauw, Omari; El Ouahdi, Adeline, Capaldo, Gronbaek, Wolfe; Daka, Vieira.
checks.rotation: Bayern lost 1-2 at Lille on Wed 25 Nov, their first defeat of the season, and Olise and Kane missed it. Kompany said he needs 'the whole squad' because of the load until Christmas, and he has named no XI. Most changes will be forced by injuries rather than chosen rest, but a young, patched-up side is likely. I could not confirm 5 or more changes, so there is no exclusion. Hamburg lost 0-4 at Bremen last weekend.
checks.motivation: Bayern are 2nd on 22 points, 2 behind Dortmund, unbeaten in 10 league games, and Kompany says the priority is a reaction to the Lille loss. Hamburg are 12th on 12 points (Yahoo's preview lists 10th, so the sources disagree). The game is not a derby for either side. Hamburg's coach is Merlin Polzin and Bayern's is Kompany. I found no manager change at either club in the last 7 days.
checks.form: Bayern's league form is D W W D W and in all competitions D W W D L, with a 1-1 draw at home to Cologne last week and a 31-game unbeaten Bundesliga away run. Hamburg are W L L W L in the league, with a 0-4 loss at Bremen last weekend. Before that they won 3 straight home league games (including 3-1 v Gladbach). I found no xG figures.
checks.h2h: Hamburg have not beaten Bayern in 19 league meetings. In the last two meetings, Bayern won 5-0 in Munich in September 2025 and the teams drew 2-2 in Hamburg in January 2026. ClubElo's all-time record is 74 Bayern wins, 25 draws and 22 Hamburg wins in 121 games. Without Kane and Olise, Bayern lose their finishing edge, which makes a repeat of the January 2-2 draw the realistic upset.
checks.odds: SportsLine's odds table (US books, best price per outcome): Bayern -278 (BetMGM) against an opening -625, draw +500 (FanDuel) against +750, Hamburg +700 (FanDuel) against +1100. The total fell from 4.5 to 3.5 and the Bayern spread from -2.5 to -1.5. De-vigged, that is about 72% Bayern, 16% draw and 12% Hamburg, which agrees with Polymarket's 74.7% to within 5 points. The line has drifted a long way from the open, but the cause is identified: Kane, Olise and Musiala out.
checks.models: ClubElo has Bayern at about 2033 and Hamburg at 1672, a gap of roughly 360 points, but I did not get a computed win probability for this match. Sports Mole predicts 1-3, Footballwhispers 1-3, and Bavarian Football Works 2-1, all for a Bayern win. Forebet returned 403 and Opta had no page for this match.
checks.venue_weather: The match is at Hamburg's home ground, the Volksparkstadion, on Sat 28 Nov, 15:30 CET (14:30 UTC), a normal home venue. I found no forecast for the day, only the climate average of about 6 C and a 55% chance of precipitation. Nothing suggests a pitch problem or extreme weather.

games.reason: The 3.9% drop in Bayern's price has a clear cause: Kane is out for months, Olise is confirmed out, Musiala is reinjured and Neuer is out. SportsLine's Bayern price has moved from -625 to -278, and the total line from 4.5 to 3.5. I start from the market and take about 2.5 points off Bayern. Bayern's attack is thinner and they have just lost at Lille. The draw is still under the 25% limit. Bayern remain far stronger (Elo gap about 360, 31 away games unbeaten, Hamburg winless in 19 against them). Confidence is low because no XI is confirmed, Musiala's status is disputed, and I found no Kicker or Bild confirmation and no bookmaker-free model forecast.
games.main_risk: Bayern's patched-up attack, without Kane, Olise and Musiala, fails to convert and Hamburg score from a set piece or counter. The game ends level, as the 2-2 in Hamburg in January did, or Bayern drop points after the Lille loss.

checks.team_news: Atlético (squad list of 22, Futbolfantasy 27 Nov 21:37): Cuti Romero (muscle, eighth straight miss), Sørloth (muscle, hurt v Viking) and Lookman (knee) are out. That leaves only Julián Álvarez and Jonathan David as forwards. Pubill is back in training and Le Normand is available. Elche (Football Faithful, Infobae): Lemar and Rubén Sánchez out; Aguado, Yago Santiago, Houary and Boayar are doubts. Fer Niño is fit (6 league goals). I could not find the text of Simeone's 27 Nov press conference, so no quotes.

Atlético: Oblak; Llorente, Le Normand or Pubill, Hancko, Grimaldo; Cardoso/Barrios/Koke/Baena/Giuliano Simeone in midfield; Álvarez up front, with Kang-In Lee or David as partner. Elche (Infobae, SI, Football Faithful): Dituro; Sangaré, Chust, Redondo, Revivo; Villar, Morcillo, Neto or Buonanotte; Cepeda, Valera, Fer Niño. Sources differ on the centre-back pair, the midfield mix and Elche's front three. No official XIs yet.

Infobae and the Atlético previews expect Simeone to rotate for the Barcelona game, but with two forwards available he cannot rotate up front. Predicted XIs show about 2-4 changes from the Viking side, not a heavy 5+ rotation, and nothing is confirmed. Elche's last game was a 1-1 draw at Levante.
checks.motivation: Atlético are 3rd, 31 points after 13 games, five points off Barcelona, so a win keeps the title race alive. Elche are 19th, 11 points, GD -6, two wins in 13, in the relegation zone and desperate. It is not a derby. Managers are Anselmi (Elche) and Simeone (Atlético), and both are named in 27-28 Nov previews, so no coach change in the last 7 days.
checks.form: Atlético: won 3-0 at Getafe and 2-0 v Viking, lost 2-1 to Barcelona and 2-0 to Man Utd. Elche: Rayo 3-0 win, Copa del Rey win v Pinatar, home losses to Valencia 0-1 and Betis 0-2, 1-1 at Levante. Elche have taken 1 point from 6 home games this season, the worst home record in the league. That favours Atlético but also shows Elche are a low-scoring home side. No xG found.
checks.h2h: Elche have won their last two home games against Atlético: 3-2 last season and 1-0 in 2022-23. Atlético won the other recent meetings, including 11 of 13 since 2013 per an undated Soccerway line. Style: Elche sit deep and are weak at home, and Atlético are expected to dominate possession. The upset history at this ground is the main concern.
checks.odds: DraftKings via ESPN: home 6.50, draw 4.70, away 1.47. De-vigged: Elche 14.7%, draw 20.3%, Atlético 65.1%. The line moved toward Atlético (open 5.25/4.20/1.56), and Polymarket's 24h move is +1.5% for Atlético. Polymarket is 13.1/19.9/67.0, so DraftKings is about 2 points below on the away side. The move is not against the favourite. No second bookmaker found.
checks.models: No bookmaker-free model forecast found for this game (searches for Opta, Forebet and ClubElo returned only older fixtures). The only forecast I saw is SI's 1-2 score prediction, and it is not a probability model.
checks.venue_weather: Estadio Martínez Valero, Elche, Saturday 28 Nov, 17:30 UTC (18:30 local); LaLiga's site confirms the date and time. It is Atlético's normal away trip with no neutral venue. Weather and pitch conditions were not found in any source.

games.reason: I started from the market and moved about 3 points of the favourite's probability to the draw and Elche, within the 5-point limit. Atlético are clearly stronger (3rd against 19th, Elche worst at home). Against that, Simeone is looking ahead to the Barcelona game on Wed 2 Dec, he has only two fit forwards (Sørloth and Lookman out, Cuti Romero out at the back), and Elche have beaten Atlético at home twice recently. DraftKings (65%) agrees with Polymarket (67%) and the price moved toward Atlético, but a 60-70% favourite is only just above the 58% hit rate we have seen. Confidence is low.
games.main_risk: Atlético rotate for Barcelona and have no forward depth, so they win a low-scoring game poorly or draw 0-0 or 1-1, or Elche score from a set piece or counter in a desperate home game, as in their 3-2 win last season.

Raimondo (ankle) and Grillitsch (hernia op) were called up on 27 Nov (TMW, Corriere dello Sport, club site), but Fantacalcio-Online still listed Raimondo as out, and Birligea, Gelli, Kone and Lolice are out. Parma: Gilardino's presser on 27 Nov ruled out Romero and Drobnjak. Diego Carlos is back in the squad and Ndiaye is back in the defensive trio. Fantacalcio-Online has Elphege/Toure and Ndiaye as doubts. Alvini's own pre-match press conference text was not found.

Parma 3-4-3 or 5-2-3 with Daffara; Ndiaye, Del Prato, Troilo; Fabbian, Keita; Elphege, Lontani, Toure. ANSA and SOS Fanta agree on Bracaglia, Bobcek and Ndiaye. Parma lost 1-5 at home to Roma on 22 Nov; their next fixture was not confirmed. 1-3 changes expected for each side, nothing near the 5+ exclusion level.
checks.motivation: Frosinone are 7th on 20 points (6W 2D 4L, goals 25:20); the promoted side is chasing survival. Parma are 17th on 8 points (2W 2D 8L, goals 10:22), one place above the drop zone, so both teams need points. Not a derby. Gilardino has been Parma coach since 27 Sep 2026 and Alvini has been at Frosinone all season; no coach changes in the last 7 days at either club.
checks.form: Frosinone have won their last 5 home league games, but lost their last two overall (Cagliari 0-1, Milan). Their matches average about 3.75 goals. Parma have 4 points from 7 under Gilardino, 8 losses in 12, lost their last two at home (Bologna 1-2, Roma 1-5), and have the league's second-worst attack. No xG figures were found.
checks.h2h: Recent senior meetings are old (Serie A 2018-19: Frosinone 3-2 at home, and 0-0 at Parma). Since 2017: 2W 1D 1L for each side at home, which is not informative. Style matchup: Frosinone's high press against Parma's leaky defence.
